rate_equation.kc_state: binary rate activity x_i=1 for KCs in the current-position group, else 0
rate_equation.mbon_rate_equation: r_j = gain * sum_i(contact_count_ij ^ alpha * x_i * weight_factor) / max_s(sum_j sum_i(contact_count_ij ^ alpha * x_i))
rate_equation.bilateral_readout: sum_j r_j over the two measured MBON-m1 cells
rate_equation.state_grouping: sort 88 measured KC IDs ascending and divide into eight non-overlapping groups of eleven
rate_equation.normalization: for each alpha, divide by the maximum bilateral anatomical drive across the eight frozen groups; no response data enter the denominator
rate_equation.time_dynamics: none in the MBON units; these are continuous rate variables, not spikes

action_interface.direction: lower bilateral MBON rate means greater action drive
action_interface.fixed_cutoff_derivation: For each alpha/gain configuration, set two non-trainable cutoffs to 0.2 times the second-smallest and sixth-smallest bilateral full-weight rate among the eight anatomy-defined states. These are calculated from pinned contact rows before running any response table.

interpretation_limit: engineering rate model; MBON activity is not represented as spikes
